Accepted residual trusted-local-toolchain assumption, not a code fix: this release/recovery/load/scanner runner resolves fixed Git/Docker or explicitly configured local executable names under the invoking developer/CI account. It is not exposed as an HTTP process-launch endpoint. Trusted PATH and installed binaries remain prerequisites; malicious local PATH can execute arbitrary code as that account. Fake-PATH failure/teardown tests intentionally exercise this boundary. Track under SEC-006; reopen if exposed to untrusted executable selection or a service account boundary.

Accepted residual local-demo credential risk, not a code fix: cocoa_dev is an intentional shared development password. Legacy Compose binds published database/API/web ports to loopback, and staging/production reject this known password even if explicitly supplied or URL-encoded. Do not use this configuration for a hosted investor or live deployment; provision separate secrets before deployment. Track under SEC-006 and reopen if the environment boundary changes.
